title: What Salesforce customers are actually building with Zapier
summary: See what two Salesforce customers built with Zapier — from 109 production Zaps to recoverable lead flows — and register for ZapConnect to meet the 2026 Zappy winners.
body_markdown:
Miranda Sambrook


Miranda Sambrook is a Partner Marketing Manager at Zapier, where she builds go-to-market programs that help technology partners grow. She specializes in turning messy, cross-functional challenges into scalable systems—and finding ways to make AI and automation do the boring parts. When she’s not thinking about partner growth, she’s probably rearranging her living room, taking too many photos of her son, or attempting to become marginally better at French with Duolingo.
